description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into five slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories are labeled as TriviaQA (red), HalluEval (green), Chinese Domain (yellow), HalluQA (blue), and an unlabeled category (purple). The proportions of these categories are approximately 46% for TriviaQA, 18% for HalluEval, 6% for Chinese Domain, 5% for HalluQA, and 25% for the unlabeled purple category. The chart includes percentage labels and numerical values for each slice, but does not include a legend. The slices are labeled directly on the chart, and none of the slices are visually emphasized. The categories appear to be listed in no particular order by size, with the largest slice, TriviaQA, being followed by the purple category, then HalluEval, and so on.
